name: China-Hongkong Photo Products Holdings Limited
summary: China-Hongkong Photo Products Holdings Limited, established in 1968 and based in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong, is a subsidiary of Searich Group Limited that markets photographic developing, processing and printing solutions in Hong Kong. Its divisions are merchandise, service and investment, selling photographic goods, skincare, consumer electronics and audio-visual equipment, and providing technical support, AV system installation and photofinishing. It runs the Fotomax retail chain and an online skincare store.
